reviews.text: Mrs. Maria is very professional, dedicated to her work, and knows exactly what a pet needs. She treats pets very well and also helps owners with their upkeep and care. Mrs. Maria is always happy to teach. I am very grateful to Mrs. Maria for everything she has taught me about taking better care of Bily. Thank you very much.

Our Arthur loves going to Maria because she's super professional and kind to him!!
We come all the way from Madrid to be seen by Maria 🐻‍❄️❤️ until November 28th, 2025 …

Bad experience. The fur was poorly trimmed, the cut was nonsensical, with longer ends next to very short ones. She forgot to trim the fur on the back of the legs and anus. A nail was left untrimmed, as well as the fur around the ears. On the belly and around the animal's genitals, the trimming was even matted.
The fur on the ears was longer than on the other side.
A one-way trip.
This lady provides a service, and those who pay for the work deserve more respect.
Before going there, check out alternatives.
Maria is super attentive and takes very good care of Wade and Malu.
